angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 712,049 km at 155.24 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.4418 +/- 0.0138 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 155.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.0235 +/- 0.0183 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 712,049 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9903 +/- 0.0358 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5811 +/- 82 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1422.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.414, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1422 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Naponiello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f2030N/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+38 5036: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1422 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.028 dex, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1422 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.04766, from Naponiello et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A...8N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1422 (pscomppars): age 4.6 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1422 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.7 km/s, from Naponiello et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A...8N/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
